actions.command: /bin/zsh -c "cat AGENTS.md; cat pnpm-workspace.yaml; cat package.json; rg -n 'parseWantedDependency|ParseWantedDependencyResult|ParsedWantedDependency|@pnpm/parse-wanted-dependency' --glob '*.ts' --glob 'package.json' --glob '"'!**/node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!**/lib/**'"'"

/bin/zsh -c "ls -la node_modules/typescript node_modules/.modules.yaml; cat packages/parse-wanted-dependency/src/index.ts; cat packages/parse-wanted-dependency/tsconfig.json; cat __utils__/tsconfig/tsconfig.json; rg -n 'parseWanted|ParsedWanted|ParseWanted|parse-wanted' --hidden --glob '"'!**/node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!**/.git/**'"' --glob '"'!**/lib/**'"' --glob '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' --glob '"'!**/*.tsbuildinfo'"'"

/bin/zsh -c "sed -n '35,62p' pkg-manager/core/package.json; cat pkg-manager/core/tsconfig.json; ls -l pkg-manager/core/node_modules/@pnpm/parse-wanted-dependency; rg --files --hidden -g '**/src/**' -g '"'!**/node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!**/lib/**'"' -g '"'!**/.git/**'"' | wc -l; git status --short"
